def transform(grid):
    """Apply vertical majority smoothing to the five embedded binary tracks."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The six signal rows are interleaved with full-color separator rows.
    signal_rows = list(range(1, h, 2))
    starts = [0, 3, 6, 9, 12]
    for ri, r in enumerate(signal_rows):
        prev_r = signal_rows[ri - 1] if ri > 0 else None
        next_r = signal_rows[ri + 1] if ri + 1 < len(signal_rows) else None
        for start in starts:
            bit_col = start + 1
            vals = [grid[rr][bit_col] for rr in (prev_r, r, next_r) if rr is not None]
            n = sum(v != 0 for v in vals)
            out[r][bit_col] = grid[r][start] if n * 2 > len(vals) else 0
    return out
